function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Reschedule an existing appointment to a new date and time. Use this when a patient wants to MOVE or CHANGE their existing appointment. This will cancel the old appointment and book the new one.

appointmentId.description: The ID of the appointment to reschedule (from identify_patient response)

date.description: The new date for the appointment (e.g., 'tomorrow', 'Monday', 'March 5th')

time.description: The new time for the appointment (e.g., '10am', '2:30 PM', '10 o'clock')

providerName.description: Optional: new provider if the patient wants to switch providers
